purpose: Define an external deterministic authorization boundary between AI agents/orchestrators and tools, data, compute or external side effects.

validation: Authenticate identity assertion with trusted issuer
Verify company, role, session and task are active
Check task scope and capability allowlist
Check resource classification and company boundary
Check approval binding and expiry where required
Check cost ceiling and zero-spend policy
Check nonce, idempotency and replay cache
Check emergency stop and policy version

allow_token_rules: Bound to one company, agent, session, task, operation, resource and scope digest
Short lived with maximum 30 second validity
Single use; nonce and request id cannot be replayed
Cannot be widened or reinterpreted by model or orchestrator
Must be revalidated at the tool boundary immediately before operation

policy_controls.company_isolation: Deny cross-company access unless an explicit owner-approved, recipient-accepted, field-scoped and time-bounded data contract is present.
policy_controls.permissions: Least privilege; explicit allowlists; no wildcard tool or resource grants.
policy_controls.approvals: Approval is bound to exact action, resource, recipient, amount, company and expiry; material changes require a new approval.
policy_controls.spending: CAD 0 maximum by default. Billable operations denied before dispatch unless the owner changes the budget policy and approves the exact spend.
policy_controls.secrets: No secret values returned to model context. Secret broker access is a separate privileged operation and is disabled by default.
policy_controls.audit: Append-only, tamper-evident decision and action records; redact secrets and unnecessary personal data.
policy_controls.revocation: Revocation and emergency stop invalidate outstanding grants and deny new operations.
policy_controls.policy_change: Policy changes require owner-authorized change control, versioning, review and audit; agents cannot propose-and-apply their own policy changes.

emergency_controls.restart: Requires authorized human release and a fresh health and policy-integrity check.
